ModMetaData.name: Vestibule
ModMetaData.author: Emiltx21
ModMetaData.description:
Vestibule\n
Assign a civilian and a special outfit to the Entryway Wardrobe, then select which door corresponds to each. When a colonist walks through one door, their outfit policy switches to the other side automatically — no manual changes needed.
The Entryway Wardrobe has 4 storage slots for clothing. For best results, add extra storage in the room, since 4 slots may not be enough to hold every colonist's spare outfit.
Localization: English, French
Requirements: none beyond base RimWorld.
This is my first mod — bug reports and suggestions are welcome.
